title: How Do You Avoid Sea Urchins When Swimming in Madeira?
description: Keep hands and feet off the rocks. Madeira urchins live on rock, boulders and pool walls, so swim in open water or wear water shoes. And what to do if stung.
heroAlt: Black sea urchins in the cracks of dark volcanic rock under shallow clear water
keywords: how to avoid sea urchins in Madeira
stepped on a sea urchin what to do
